prompt: Create an animated VFX sprite sheet: the GROUND SPLITS UNDER A HEAVY SWORD BLOW and a low dust wave throws stones. Side-view RPG battle camera, slight 3/4 from the front. GROUND LINE at 86% of the cell height, impact point horizontally centred. Palette: grey-brown stone, dark earth seam, sandy dust; no glow, no colour light. Frame 1: a narrow diagonal split opens in the ground, its two stone edges slightly displaced. Frame 2: a low ground-hugging dust wave bursts out from the split to both sides, 5-7 heavy stone fragments thrown sideways and low. Frame 3: the dust wave widest (95% of the cell width), stones highest (30% of the cell height). Frame 4: stones falling fast. Frame 5: stones landing, dust rolling low. Frame 6: dust thinning. Frame 7: the split seam and a few stones. Frame 8: fading. LAYOUT: exactly eight frames in a 2 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS grid of equal square cells, tall 1024x2048 canvas, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom, one continuous one-shot effect. Clean HD painterly anime game VFX matching a chibi fantasy RPG, NOT pixel art; everything painted fully opaque with crisp shapes (no soft haze, no smoke, no translucent fog). No character, no creature, no hero, no hand, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no ground plate, no floor, no shadow. Everything stays fully inside its own cell with at least 6% magenta padding on all four sides in every frame. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta, no gradient. Never use magenta, pink or purple in the effect.

problems.detail: The dust clouds in several frames, especially the middle rows, carry a pink/magenta tint that bleeds from the key colour into the effect, which the prompt explicitly forbids.
Frame 2 and frame 3 dust reaches within about 4% of the left and right canvas edges, below the required 6% magenta padding on all four sides of each cell.

precheck.summary: The layout is correct (8 frames in 2 columns by 4 rows on a flat magenta background) and the stone-and-dust subject matches the prompt, but the dust picks up pink tinting that the prompt forbids and some dust extends too close to the cell edges.
